# Governance Protocol & Code of Conduct

## 1. DX Standards & Engineering Excellence

`GLASTOR Core pii-veil` (maintained by **GLASTOR Core**) is more than just code: it is a mission-critical data loss prevention (DLP), AI privacy, and high-performance systems engineering project built in Rust. Our goal is to scale sensitive data protection solutions while maintaining an exceptional Developer Experience (DX) and clean modular architecture across all 6 distribution channels. This protocol ensures that our collaboration remains as robust, predictable, and disciplined as our technology stack, fostering a high-signal environment where technical excellence and professional respect converge.

## 2. Pillars of Sustainable Software Engineering

To uphold the integrity of our codebase, architecture, and community, all participants adhere to the following standards:

### High-Impact Collaboration

- **Technical Empathy & Peer Review:** We conduct code reviews and architecture discussions with rigorous technical standards and genuine professional courtesy. We prioritize software security, safety, and correctness over author ego.
- **Transparent Accountability:** We acknowledge logic errors, detector false positives/negatives, or communication misses immediately, transforming them into opportunities for optimization, tests, and documentation.
- **Data-Driven Feedback:** All proposals must be grounded in reproducible benchmarks (`veil bench`), mathematical checksum proofs (Luhn, ISO 13616 Mod-97, Mod-23, Mod-11), streaming regression tests, or protocol standards (JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP, RFC 4180 CSV), avoiding subjective bias.

### Technical & Social Boundaries (Zero Tolerance)

- **Harassment & Toxicity:** Any behavior or communication that compromises psychological safety or mutual respect will be addressed and mitigated immediately.
- **Disruption & Trolling:** Bad-faith argumentation, disruption of issue trackers, or trolling in PR discussions degrades project velocity and will not be tolerated.
- **Privacy Violations (Doxxing):** As a project dedicated to privacy, anonymization, and PII protection, the confidentiality of our users and contributors is paramount. Never post real personal data, live API keys, or production secrets in issues, PRs, or test fixtures. Exposing real personal data results in immediate, permanent revocation of repository access.

## 3. Governance & Maintainer Responsibilities

The maintainers of **GLASTOR Core pii-veil** (@glastor-core and @glastor-dev) serve as the architecture and moderation council. Maintainers have the authority and responsibility to:

- Provide impartial mediation during technical disagreements and architectural reviews.
- Reject contributions that fail to meet quality gates (zero Clippy warnings, 100% test pass, zero mock PII in fixtures) or conduct standards.
- Enforce appropriate corrective measures aligned with the long-term health and stability of the repository.

## 4. Scope

This code of conduct applies within all project spaces (`https://github.com/glastor-core/pii-veil`) and in any public representation of the project (conferences, technical forums, registry distribution channels such as crates.io, PyPI, npm, and official communications).

## 5. Incident Response Protocol (IRP)

If you witness or experience unacceptable behavior:
1. Privately contact our team at: **[founder@glastor.es](mailto:founder@glastor.es)**.
2. All reports are evaluated confidentially within 48 business hours.
3. Resolutions will be applied with discretion to protect reporting parties.
